class.name: BrakePressureTableItem
class.brief_description: A single row of the brake pressure table (BPT), mapping a brake handle position to pipe/cylinder pressure and brake type.
class.description: Each [BrakePressureTableItem] corresponds to one line of the [code]BPT[/code] table, which appears right after the [code]Cntrl.[/code] section in a FIZ file. It is not a dense, zero-based array like most other list sections - the handle position (which can be negative, e.g. for the release position) is stored explicitly on each item via [member handle_position].

members.member: [code]BPT:C[/code] Pressure in the brake cylinder for this handle position. [code]-1[/code] means not applicable.
[code]BPT:E[/code] The brake type used at this handle position.
[code]BPT:D[/code] Fill speed for this handle position.
[code]BPT:A[/code] The brake handle position number this row applies to. Can be negative.
[code]BPT:B[/code] Pressure in the main (train) pipe for this handle position, in MPa.
